channel.title: The Seven Year Itch
channel.desc: A New York publisher's family loyalty is put to the test when a beautiful model moves in next door while his wife is on vacation. Lonely without his family, the imaginative man begins to fantasise about what could have been with all the women he has forsaken in marriage. Thus when the attractive woman arrives on the scene, his impure thoughts could well become a reality.
